svg.title: One forward run, two backward trajectories
svg.desc: Forward propagation records a boundary tape and final physical state. During backward, the reconstructed forward field and the separate adjoint field meet in material-gradient accumulation.

g.aria-label: One forward run, two backward trajectories
Same time index, different roles. Reconstruction supplies saved forward information.
The adjoint carries loss sensitivity; their contractions produce model gradients.
StarWave · Implementation schematic, not simulation data
